title: In view mode, if laser pointer was active, stopping view mode, the active tool will default to hand
app_version: master, Feb 2026 (regression from PR #10802); pre-fix = cae9d2b^1
bug_description: After using the laser pointer (K) in view mode and pressing Esc, exiting view mode leaves the Hand tool active instead of the Selection tool; embeddables also stop being interactive after Esc.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Add an embeddable. 2) Switch to view mode (can interact with embeddable). 3) Press K to activate laser pointer. 4) Press Esc to quit laser pointer (embeddable no longer interactive). 5) Exit view mode -> Hand tool remains active.
expected: Selection tool is active after exiting view mode; embeddable stays interactive after leaving laser mode.
actual: Hand tool stays active after exiting view mode.
run_locally: git clone https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw && cd excalidraw && git checkout cae9d2b^1 && yarn && yarn start  # http://localhost:3000
difficulty_reason: Keyboard shortcuts + toolbar state; assert via active tool button. Embeddable step optional (bug at step 5 reproduces without it).

title: bug in changing X Y params of a frame via Properties
bug_description: Changing a frame's X or Y in the stats/properties panel moves the frame but not the elements inside it.
steps_to_reproduce: (derived) 1) Draw a frame (F). 2) Draw a rectangle inside it. 3) Select the frame, open stats panel (Alt+/). 4) Change X (or Y) value. 5) Frame moves; rectangle stays put.
expected: Children of the frame move with the frame (same as dragging).
actual: Only the frame moves; contained elements stay at old position and fall out of the frame.
run_locally: git clone https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw && cd excalidraw && git checkout 6e655cd^1 && yarn && yarn start  # http://localhost:3000
difficulty_reason: Simple canvas drawing + numeric input; assert via exported scene JSON or element positions.

title: Can't navigate to sidebar category when browsing a page within that category
bug_description: Clicking a linked sidebar category label while on a child doc only collapses the category instead of navigating to the category index page.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Open /docs/sidebar. 2) Navigate to a doc in this category, e.g. /docs/sidebar/items. 3) Click the 'Sidebar' category label -> it collapses but does not navigate.
expected: Category index page (/docs/sidebar) is displayed.
actual: Category toggles collapsed state; URL stays on child doc.
run_locally: git clone https://github.com/facebook/docusaurus && cd docusaurus && git checkout 60df493^1 && yarn install && yarn start:website  # http://localhost:3000
difficulty_reason: Pure navigation; assert URL after click.

title: Footnotes (when navigating from Footnotes section) are covered by navbar
bug_description: Clicking the back-reference link in the Footnotes section scrolls the referenced text under the sticky navbar so the footnote marker is hidden.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Open a page with footnotes; scroll to the Footnotes section at the bottom. 2) Click the back-link of a footnote. 3) With a static navbar the footnote reference is hidden behind the navbar.
expected: The footnote reference is visible below the navbar after clicking the back-link.
actual: Reference is scrolled behind the navbar; user must scroll up to see it.
run_locally: git clone https://github.com/facebook/docusaurus && cd docusaurus && git checkout 1592094^1 && yarn install && yarn start:website  # add a doc with GFM footnotes if none exists
seed_note: A markdown page containing footnotes ([^1]). Second video shows the hidden-navbar (non-buggy) case for comparison.
difficulty_reason: Click + scroll position assertion (boundingBox of ref vs navbar).

title: [autocomplete] When disableCloseOnSelect={true}, scroll resets to top on option selection when popup is reopened by clicking the input
bug_description: In the Checkboxes Autocomplete demo, selecting an option after scrolling the listbox jumps the scroll position back to the top (when popup was reopened by clicking the input).
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Open /material-ui/react-autocomplete/#checkboxes. 2) Open the autocomplete and scroll the popup. 3) Select an item. 4) Scroll jumps to top.
expected: Listbox scroll position is preserved after selecting an option.
actual: Listbox scrollTop resets to 0.
run_locally: git clone https://github.com/mui/material-ui && cd material-ui && git checkout a8af64e^1 && pnpm install && pnpm docs:dev  # http://localhost:3000/material-ui/react-autocomplete/#checkboxes
difficulty_reason: Click/scroll/click; assert listbox scrollTop.

title: [Select][7.3.0] Select inside Dialog bug
bug_description: Clicking a Select inside a Dialog opens the menu and the same click immediately selects the option under the pointer and closes the menu.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Open demo https://stackblitz.com/edit/2numcwtv?file=src%2FDemo.tsx (Select inside Dialog). 2) Click the Age select.
expected: Menu opens and waits for the user to choose an option.
actual: Menu opens, an item is selected and the menu closes in a single click.
run_locally: npm create vite@latest repro -- --template react-ts && cd repro && npm i @mui/material@7.3.0 @emotion/react @emotion/styled && paste Demo.tsx from the StackBlitz && npm run dev
difficulty_reason: Single click; assert menu still open / value unchanged. Pointer-position dependent but deterministic.

fix.note: Revert of pointer-cancellation PR #45789; reimplemented later in PR #48328

title: Right-click does not show the context menu outside the select tool
bug_description: With any tool other than Select active, right-clicking the canvas changes the cursor but shows no context menu (DefaultContextMenuContent returns null when select tool inactive).
steps_to_reproduce: (derived) 1) Choose the Draw (D) or Rectangle tool. 2) Right-click on the canvas. 3) No context menu appears.
expected: Context menu appears on right-click regardless of the active tool.
actual: No context menu is rendered.
run_locally: git clone https://github.com/tldraw/tldraw && cd tldraw && git checkout ed0799d^1 && yarn && yarn dev  # examples app http://localhost:5420
difficulty_reason: Tool select + right-click; assert menu role visible. Note maintainers treated it as a feature change.

title: [Dialog] Overlay renders on top of dialog when reopened
bug_description: On the second and later openings of a Dialog (Dialog.Trigger or overlay manager), the backdrop is stacked above the dialog content, blocking interaction.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Open a dialog. 2) Close it. 3) Open the same dialog again. 4) Overlay covers the dialog; it is not interactable.
expected: Overlay always behind dialog content; dialog stays interactive.
actual: Overlay covers dialog content on re-open.
run_locally: npm create vite@latest repro -- --template react-ts && cd repro && npm i @chakra-ui/react@3.29.0 @emotion/react && render the docs Dialog example (with overlay manager) && npm run dev
difficulty_reason: Open/close/open; assert a button inside dialog is clickable (elementFromPoint).

fix.note: Closed without a linked PR; likely fixed in a later @chakra-ui/react / zag-js release. Expected behavior is clear.

expected: Clicking the 1st sets the field value to that date.
actual: Picker closes without setting the value (date) / needs two clicks (dateTime).
